purpose: Stable runtime boundary for cross-polity joint research. Diplomacy owns agreements and political/legal consequences; Adaptive Research owns scientific contribution validation, joint progress, result delivery, and assimilation.

external_input_events.payload: collaboration id, participants, objective disclosure, contribution commitments, result rights, active/suspended/terminated state
external_input_events.effect: create/update/terminate research collaboration record; no RP created by agreement
revalidate only affected participant contribution and joint stage blockers

external_input_events.payload: participant/context path, latency, bandwidth, secure-channel availability

external_input_events.effect: revalidate authorized contributions/result dissemination without changing scientific truth

external_input_events.payload: collaboration + participant + effective time + access/assets actually removed
external_input_events.effect: remove future contribution, re-evaluate blockers/progress, preserve already delivered records
update future result-delivery authorization; does not recall already delivered material

external_input_events.payload: jointly studied foreign asset/sample/record/expert access changed
external_input_events.effect: re-evaluate joint foreign-tech/evidence/tacit contribution and each participant assessment

external_queries.output: eligible/limited/ineligible plus concrete known blockers and opportunity-cost references
validated aggregate Effective Research Labs, facility/evidence/material/tacit availability, participating contexts, and blockers; no treaty bonus
actual current contributions, directed-program usage, result rights/access, known blockers, result-delivery state
known result components/rights expected for participant plus technical/applicability limitations; never hidden partner tree data
known capacity/facility/material/integration losses and whether project would continue/slow/block/pause

external_queries.input: collaboration objective + legitimately known offered partner contributions
external_queries.output: research utility based only on offered/known real assets/capabilities/readiness, not hidden partner tech

materialization_pipeline: receive active diplomatic collaboration facts and objective disclosure
verify objective is legitimately visible/disclosed to each participant at required detail
validate each contribution independently against real participant state
reserve each active research participant's directed-program position where required
reserve/assign real Effective Research Labs/facilities/experts/materials/data without duplication
create one joint project progress record or collaboration-specific non-directed program record
emit concrete blockers for missing scientific/access/communications/security requirements
progress_pipeline: aggregate eligible real labs under canonical diminishing returns
compute stage readiness from actual contributing competence/facility/evidence/tacit inputs without double-counting assets
respect material communications/coordination blockers only where real
advance one joint project stage work record
apply field competence/practice gain only to actual contributors
on stage/result transition create participant-specific result packages/delivery records
result_delivery_pipeline: derive participant package components/rights from collaboration agreement
transmit codified data through real communication paths/latency
move physical hardware/experts/tooling only through actual logistics if included
apply result to each participant using native co-development or normal foreign/tacit assimilation rules as appropriate
remove redundant delivery records after participant state incorporates them

requirements: participant actually contributed scientific work to relevant stage(s)
participant consumed required directed-program capacity when actively directing research
participant had necessary objective access and applicability for its target context
participant receives the result records/rights necessary for its own scientific state
normal maturation stage result is reached by the joint project
native_co_development_rule.effect: Participant may advance its own corresponding native node state because it co-developed the result; this is not a free technology grant.
native_co_development_rule.passive_participant: Funding/hosting/result receipt without scientific participation uses normal evidence/tacit/foreign-transfer assimilation instead.
